name: SnapOG

product.name: SnapOG

presets.deliverableHint: Pricing model in docs/cfo/, tier comparison table, copy-ready pricing section for snapog.dev landing.

presets.deliverableHint: Launch brief in docs/product/, copy in docs/marketing/, checklist with owners in docs/operations/.

presets.deliverableHint: Save audit as markdown in docs/research/ with at least 5 actionable fixes and before/after copy.

presets.taskTemplate: Run a marketing sprint for SnapOG: positioning angle for indie devs, channel plan (PH, Twitter, dev communities), and one publish-ready asset.
presets.deliverableHint: Each agent saves deliverables under docs/{role}/ — final asset must be ready to post (not outline-only).

presets.taskTemplate: Ship one vertical feature slice for SnapOG — spec, implementation plan in projects/snapog/, and QA acceptance criteria.
presets.deliverableHint: Spec in docs/product/, implementation notes in docs/fullstack/ referencing projects/snapog/src/.

presets.taskTemplate: Weekly review for SnapOG: API usage metrics, revenue, blockers, and one prioritized growth experiment.
presets.deliverableHint: CEO summary + ops metrics in docs/operations/ and docs/ceo/.

profileSeed.summary: SnapOG — Open Graph image API on Cloudflare Workers with R2 cache and Stripe tiers.
profileSeed.valueProposition: Generate stunning OG images via a simple GET API — sub-100ms on cache hit, global edge.
profileSeed.targetAudience: Indie developers, bloggers, and SaaS founders who need OG images without design tools.
profileSeed.problemStatement: Manual OG design is slow; competitors like Bannerbear and Placid are expensive at indie scale.
profileSeed.businessModel: Freemium API SaaS: Free (100/mo), Pro $19/mo (10k), Business $49/mo (100k).
profileSeed.monetizationHypothesis: Pro tier at $19/mo with watermark-free images and higher limits drives ramen profitability.
profileSeed.nextAction: Run pricing-and-monetization preset, then product-launch for landing + Stripe checkout.

defaultNextAction: Apply SnapOG vertical pack complete — run pricing-and-monetization from the war room.
